performance_case.causal_mechanism: A point-in-time D-1 expiry-futures inventory plus complete confirmed D-day expiry-futures and BTC-USDT index atoms can test whether lagged fixed-maturity carry contains independent DRA admission information without same-day leakage.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance proves only an offline fixed-origin Java producer core and byte-level contract compatibility. It cannot prove public endpoint availability, reliable capture, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, deployment, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future reduction in adverse DRA entry path or maximum drawdown remains MISSING_PROOF until prospective data supports a preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The current carry source is frozen but cannot collect evidence. A bounded producer core reduces time to evidence while avoiding premature filesystem transport, deployment and source registration; failure preserves the accepted source design with no sunk operational surface.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The producer core cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but exact causal capture reduces the latency and evidence-integrity cost of accepting or rejecting one primary-supported carry mechanism without reopening closed exit-management branches.
